name: Birdwatcher Moira

intro.text: Curlews, lapwings, redshank, all nesting in the hay meadows. We stay out till June to let them. Now, shh.

win: That'll have put the curlews off. I've never been so embarrassed.
after: A curlew's call is the sound of the moor. I'd miss it more than my own phone.
